caption: The drawing is composed of six rectangular sections arranged in two rows on a cream background, each depicting different scenes with earthy and vibrant colors. In the top left section, a brown stag with large antlers is shown in profile against a brown background. Next to it in the middle top section, a hunter in red is partially obscured by foliage as he points a rifle toward the right, on a similarly brown background. The top right section features a person dressed in light green traditional attire with an elaborate sash, feeding a white bird perched on a tall stand, against a bright red background filled with green plants. In the bottom left section, a similar scene to the top left is shown with the stag in profile, but this time with a pale blue sky and beige and light brown hues for the animal and foliage, and a partial figure of a hunter in red aiming a rifle from the bushes on the right. In the lower center-right section, a rooster with dark brown and green feathers and a red crest stands beside a white hen and six yellow chicks on a green and brown ground, with a cage in the background. The style uses crosshatch shading and a tapestry-like texture throughout all sections.
title: Four Textile Samples
